reviews.review:
Worth every penny. Tons of playstyles, build options. It can be super easy or super hard with difficulty options that you can reroll anytime if you over or underestimated or just want to vibe instead of sweating. I find the co op scaling a little overzealous personally but it probably isn't really that bad. 

My only complaints are I wish we had about 50 more loadout slots and didn't NEED to go to the wiki for double checking things as hard.

Awesome co-op game.
There aren’t many games that do this kind of experience so well anymore. Tough fights, great build variety, and a lot of fun

I didn't like the game, first one was better. There were a few decent boss fights with riveting design, a couple of cool armour sets, new classes, but everything else the game has to offer is terrible.

The main story is basically non existent, no ending, last boss is... I don't even know how they've decided to come up with that after the first game. Randomly generated dungeons is absolutely disgraceful and force you to re-roll an * number of times until you get what you need. An insane amount of rings and amulets, which make 2/3 of all loot in the game if not more, and most of them are useless.

Puzzles are not intuitive at all and there were a couple of times when I had to google what to do after spending a good 20-30 minutes trying to solve it. And the solution each time was so off that I have no clue how the devs came up with that. Also worth to mention that many quest chains and ways to obtain some of the items need to be googled as well, because no way you could think of something like that by yourself.

Dungeons with traps. There were a few of them in the game and they're truly horrible to complete.

Bugs. Often the game was not registering hits on enemies; achievements not popping up when the requirements are met; my character fell so many times in places where I needed to jump, because, for some reason, jump was not working.

Game's performance and optimization in such a terrible state, with often stutters, freezes and fps drops on all settings. Like there is truly no difference in playing on Ultra vs Low with minimal screen resolution, frame gen and an upscaler. The only thing that saved me from a refund was me not playing alone, don't recommend it.
You need a guide pulled up on another monitor or you'll be lost as hell. Fun concept but, poor level design.
